notes.title: 【Version 1.68】
notes.content:
Optimization Features:
* A quick remove attachment button has been added to the weapon modification interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779087/a2c2588b5e55586f162c755ed6b055d4a45d22af.png[/img]

* Chests that have been searched by pets will now display in cyan text, distinguishing between those only searched by pets and those searched by players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779087/839a6e8bc56c44e80c80564174c66ebb4ce5e9b6.png[/img]

* New right-click function: Split. This allows you to split a stack of items into half the quantity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779087/963db09a6f659002234efab06318d7068f7adfe9.png[/img]

* When opening your backpack and being attacked, a red notification box will appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779087/b302957e0bacb9a603bc3428febfad1479ef6a02.png[/img]

* A new toggle switch has been added to the settings interface: Auto Reload. When enabled, it automatically reloads when ammunition is depleted.
* A new toggle switch has been added to the settings interface: Auto Rotate. When enabled, it will automatically attempt to rotate and transfer items if fast item transfer is obstructed.
* A new toggle switch has been added to the settings interface: Auto Organize. When enabled, while looting items, the items quickly picked up from loot boxes will automatically find suitable containers and be organized accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779087/f97235e68e22f628eba2dd47eb072ba7d813e669.png[/img]

* New backpack feature – Merge Similar Items. Clicking this will automatically merge stackable items without moving other items' positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779087/660320a3818474ca96904df326cd7003f93dfd79.png[/img]

* New backpack feature – Get Marked Items. This functions similarly to [Get All], but it only picks up items that have been marked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779087/e1ac8e2d39fe5f143d79371a20f6c28514c9783b.png[/img]

Bug Fixes:
* The issue where NPCs on the player's back would disappear has been fixed.
* The conflict between final mission and repeatable mission conditions has been resolved.
* The problem where re-quick-placing items from the backpack would result in loss of quantity has been fixed.
* The issue where picking up a backpack while switching warehouses would cause the warehouse to close has been fixed.
* The issue where smoke grenades would cause enemies to lose their target for an extended period has been fixed.
* The issue where pet backpack container notes would be lost has been fixed.
* The problem where rapid clicking on under-barrel grenade launchers would interrupt reloading has been fixed.
* Some incorrect radio messages have been corrected.
* Some backpack UI interaction issues have been resolved.

The current update plan has been fully completed. Afterwards, I will take a break for some time before proceeding with several sporadic updates: fixing some bugs, learning how to optimize certain issues, and adding new weapons, among other things.

At the same time, preparations are being made to bring you a new game. The production of "Night Raiders 2" is about to commence, and its content will cover the story before the rookie joins the Night Raiders camp in this current game.

notes.title: 【Version 1.50】【Version 1.51】
notes.content:
【Version 1.50】
* New quest system: Main quest (story), side quest, delegated quest (repeat)
* New archive system: A total of three archives can be created, the old archive is still available, but it may affect the game experience and affect some recording functions, we recommend that you create a new archive to play. A new save will adjust the difficulty of each part of the game.
* New modification system: Can more intuitively understand the weapon can be added to the modification accessories. And when modifying in the camp, you can read all the modified parts in the warehouse. Accessories that cannot be used in the current firearm will not be displayed in the modification system. An accessory marked in red means you can use it, but you don't own it.
* New computer APP-WSTalk
* New bosses: 10 main quest bosses (some dedicated to story and main quest), one wandering BOSS (Crow), using melee weapons to attack enemies. When there is a BOSS 'ghost' on the map, crows will appear)
* New enemies: 4 human enemies and 1 Zombie enemy
* New weapons (41) : 2 pistols, 2 submachine guns, 15 assault rifles, 1 precision shooter rifle, 4 machine guns, 4 sniper rifles, 6 shotguns, 7 melee weapons
* New accessories (64) : 6 muzzles, 6 grips, 11 stocks, 9 magazines, 30 scopes, a dedicated undermount launcher, and a more advanced night vision
* New ammos: 12 new models of existing ammos, 9 new caliber ammos, and 1 new type of 40mm grenade
* New items: 11 new food items (crafting), 1 new top medical item, 1 new top armor Recovery item, 1 new top repair tool, 1 new Throwing item
* New items: 15 dolls, 16 quest items, 2 collection items
* Black Marketeer Change: Renamed Kyle. The sale content is unlocked according to the progress of the main task, and the sale content is fixed. And after the completion of the main task can unlock the gold card purchase.
* Arms Dealer change: Renamed Zavier. No longer selling items, but an important character in the main story.
* Repairman change: Repair tools are sold separately, and emergency repair function is completed at one time
* Otaku Change: The computer upgrade will be changed to the exclusive quest of Otaku, and the items required for the computer upgrade will be changed
* Workbench changes: Some recipes require a design diagram lock, which can be obtained through Cooper's side quest
* New recipes added to the worktable: 9 new food preparations
* Online shopping added: 6 new weapons (need to complete the specified main quest to unlock)
* New NPCS: 4 human NPCS (Echo, a helicopter pilot and member of the Orga Defense Organization)
* BOSS attack mode changed: The attack mode of Dr. D zombies changed to tentacle attack, summoning long-range tentacle monsters (pay attention to whether there is a red attack warning under your feet, you can avoid tentacle attack). At the same time, the BOSS's attack power and health are greatly reduced.
* Some NPCS and enemies change their appearance
* In the last update to the scope, some attributes have been adjusted, magnification has been adjusted, and the overall critical chance has been improved
* Maximum stack number of loaves increased to 5
* Grenade bags can be picked up from military vehicles and removed from online shopping

【Version 1.51】
*New System: Weapon Wall. Allows you to collect and display weapons from your inventory on the Weapon Wall. You can also retrieve weapons by clicking on them on the Weapon Wall.
*Significantly Reduced Refresh Time for Repeatable Missions (Note: New repeatable missions will only appear after you complete the previous one).
*Fixed Bullet Rewards for Repeatable Missions changed to Supply Vouchers. Players can use Supply Vouchers at the Workbench to exchange for the high-grade bullets they truly need. Due to the significantly reduced refresh time *for repeatable missions, the number of Supply Vouchers rewarded is lower compared to the original rewards.
*New Recipes Added to the Workbench (requires unlocking with blueprints): 8.6mm Bullets, 8.6mm TB, 8.6mm AP, 8.6mm HP.
*New Recipes Added to the Workbench: High-level variants of various bullets, which can be exchanged using Supply Vouchers.
*New Recipe Added to the Workbench: Smoke Grenade.
*Enemies attacked by drones will no longer find the player's location
*Decoy bombnow force the attention of 3 zombies until the effect ends.
*New Item: Supply Voucher.
*Added manual save game button in ESC interface
*Adjusted the layout of some camps, added new explanations to the operation manual.
*Restricted the attack range of the Lab Boss, providing players with safe areas to heal.
*Fixed a bug where only rain weather would appear.
*Fixed a bug where bullets refunded during quick modifications would disappear.
*Fixed a bug where prohibited accessory slots could be equipped during quick modifications.
*Fixed a bug where certain attachments were displayed multiple times during modifications.

notes.title: Version 1.50 update delayed
notes.content:
* I am very sorry that I had a stomach problem recently and went to the hospital. The update needs to be postponed until the end of the month. The specific date depends on the physical recovery.
* Part completed so far:
1. 34 new weapons were created, including 2 pistols, 2 submachine guns, 6 shotguns, 15 assault rifles, 1 precision shooter rifle, 4 machine guns, and 4 sniper rifles.
2. 64 new modified parts were made.
3. 22 new bullets were created.
4. New modification interface, more convenient and quick modification.
5. Created 4 new human enemies, 11 new BOSS level enemies, and 5 new mainline-related NPCS
6. Made 4 new props and 15 collectible doll props
7. The new version of some old NPCS has been adjusted
8. The mission system is half completed

notes.title: 【Version 1.50 Production progress】
notes.content:
*Due to the fact that version 1.50 is a major update, which includes all the contents of versions 1.46, 1.47, 1.48, 1.49 and 1.50 originally planned, the content production will take a long time, and is tentatively scheduled to be completed in early August if nothing happens. It may be extended if health conditions fail, but it is being made as soon as possible.
*The content that will be introduced at that time includes the story, mission system, new enemies and bosses, new guns, new modification accessories, new bullet types, new items, new modification interface, multi-saving system, weapon walls and more
*The current progress has been completed:
1.34 new weapons were produced, including 2 pistols, 2 submachine guns, 6 shotguns, 15 assault rifles, 1 precision shooter rifle, 4 machine guns, and 4 sniper rifles.
2.64 new retrofit accessories were produced.
3.22 new bullets.
4. New modification interface, more convenient and quick modification.
*Already working on the quest system and story aspects. Due to the intense production of content, coupled with the development of a solo, limited energy, may be in various social channels to view the message and reply to the slow, or miss the message.
